conversations.user_input: User: What do you know about the Math department at HKUST ?
conversations.response:
The Department of Mathematics at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) boasts a diverse faculty with expertise in various fields of mathematics and statistics. Some notable faculty members include:

- Chi Wai Yu, who holds a PhD in Statistics from The University of British Columbia and serves as an Assistant Professor of Science Education.
- Yin Bon Ku, with a PhD in Mathematics from the University of California, Los Angeles, is a Lecturer in the department.
- Tsz Kin Lam, who earned his PhD in Mathematics from The State University of New York at Stony Brook, is also a Lecturer.
- Jing Yao, with a PhD in Systems Analysis and Integration from the National University of Defense Technology, serves as a Lecturer.
- Guibo Ye, who holds a PhD in Applied Mathematics from Fudan University, is another Lecturer in the department.

The department also includes Assistant Professors like Shuoqing Deng, Xinzhou Guo, Quoc Ho, Qingyuan Jiang, and Maximilian Alexander Nitzschner, each with impressive academic backgrounds from prestigious universities around the world.

For more detailed information, you can visit their faculty profiles at [HKUST Faculty Profiles](https://facultyprofiles.hkust.edu.hk/).

conversations.user_input: User: What happens if I fail a course? Can I retake it?
conversations.response:
If you fail a course at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, the grade F will be included in your record and in the calculation of your Term Grade Average (TGA) and Cumulative Grade Average (CGA). You can retake the course, but normally only once. If you need to repeat it more than once, you'll require approval from the relevant Dean or the Dean’s designee. For students admitted in the 2023-24 intake or after, when you repeat a failed course, the previous F grade will be excluded from the calculation of any grade averages, and only the latest attempt will count. For students admitted in the 2022-23 intake or before, both the previous F grade and the repeated attempt will be included in the TGA and CGA calculations.

conversations.user_input: User: What are the requirements for being placed on the Dean's List?
conversations.response:
To be placed on the Dean’s List at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, undergraduate students must meet the following requirements at the end of the Fall or Spring Term: 

1. Achieve a Term Grade Average (TGA) of at least 3.7, calculated from at least 12 credits registered.
2. Have not failed any course.
3. Have not committed any confirmed act of academic dishonesty.

Source: [HKUST Academic Regulations](https://www.ust.hk)
